title: cyclelanes: bike infrastructure from OpenStreetMap and city open data
text: Bicycle infrastructure place, tidy sf object. cyclelanes pulls every bicycle-related way place OpenStreetMap, normalises dozen-odd OSM tagging conventions one facility taxonomy per-side classification, can run city’s official bike-facility inventory taxonomy two can summarised compared. Denver, Colorado built-worked example; cities plug source registry. Google Maps source, one: Google exposes bike-lane data endpoint terms forbid scraping map layer. OpenStreetMap data actually lives. Documentation worked Denver example: https://mjorden.github.io/cyclelanes/.

code: library(cyclelanes)  # 1. OpenStreetMap, any place name or bounding box. A place name is #    clipped to its administrative boundary, so this is Denver proper, #    not the bounding box that spills into Lakewood and Aurora. denver <- cl_bike_lanes("Denver, Colorado") cl_summary(denver) #>          facility_type n_segments length_km length_mi share #> 1       separated_path       1843     412.7     256.4 0.41 #> 2       protected_lane        212      48.1      29.9 0.05 #> ...  cl_plot(denver, title = "Denver bike facilities (OpenStreetMap)")  # 2. How well do they agree? cmp <- cl_compare(denver, official, tolerance = 15) cmp #> <cl_comparison> tolerance = 15 m #>    layer n_segments length_km matched_km matched_frac #>      osm       ... #> official       ...  # Official facilities that OSM does not know about missing <- dplyr::filter(cmp$official, matched_frac < 0.5) cl_plot(missing) lodo <- cl_bike_lanes(c(-105.005, 39.740, -104.985, 39.752)) lanes <- cl_classify(denver_lodo$osm, drop_none = TRUE) cl_compare(lanes, denver_lodo$official)

code: cl_fetch_osm(   place,   timeout = 180,   clip = TRUE,   overpass_url = NULL,   retries = 3,   tile = NULL,   cache = FALSE,   cache_dir = cl_cache_dir(),   cache_max_age = 30 )

title: Fetch raw bicycle-related ways from OpenStreetMap — cl_fetch_osm
text: place One : place name geocoded Nominatim, e.g. "Denver, Colorado" (respect Nominatim usage policy: one request per second, bulk geocoding); numeric vector c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) WGS84 degrees; sf, sfc, bbox object CRS; 2 x 2 matrix returned osmdata::getbb(). timeout Overpass server timeout seconds. City-scale queries can take minute ; public Overpass instance rejects long-running queries, keep place metro area smaller. clip Overpass takes bounding box, box around city usually spills neighbours. TRUE (default) clips result place's administrative boundary cl_boundary() place name; ways crossing boundary cut . Pass sf/sfc polygon clip boundary kind place, FALSE keep whole box. Ignored bbox sf inputs unless polygon supplied. overpass_url Overpass endpoint call , e.g. "https://overpass.private.coffee/api/interpreter". Must end /interpreter. session-wide default set osmdata::set_overpass_url() restored afterwards. retries many times retry transient failure (429, 502, 503, 504, timeout) giving . Waits start 30 s double, jitter, capped 5 minutes. tile Split bounding box tiles many degrees side query , de-duplicating ways osm_id. NULL (default) sends one query. Use around 0.25 areas time ; note tile separate request server's per-address rate limit. cache Store raw Overpass result cache_dir reuse bounding box within cache_max_age days. cache_dir Directory cached results; see cl_cache_dir(). cache_max_age Maximum age days cached result reuse.

title: Fetch raw bicycle-related ways from OpenStreetMap — cl_fetch_osm
text: sf object LINESTRINGs WGS84 (EPSG:4326) raw OSM tag columns present area. zero-row sf nothing matched. WGS84 bounding box queried stored attr(x, "cl_bbox"), clipping polygon () attr(x, "cl_boundary"), fetch time attr(x, "cl_fetched") (original fetch time cache hit).

text: Overpass shared public service answers HTTP 429 address queries often 504 overloaded. retried exponential backoff (retries), mirror can used one call (overpass_url), large areas can split tiles (tile), results can cached disk (cache) re-run script hit server .

title: cyclelanes 0.2.0
text: “Trustworthy numbers”: everything first city-wide Denver run exposed.

title: cyclelanes 0.2.0
text: cl_fetch_osm() cl_bike_lanes() clip place-name query place’s administrative boundary (clip = TRUE, via new cl_boundary()), “Denver, Colorado” longer includes Lakewood Aurora. cl_fetch_official(bbox = ) accepts polygon (#2). Overpass resilience: transient failures (429/502/503/504/timeouts) retried exponential backoff; overpass_url uses mirror one call; tile splits large boxes; cache = TRUE stores results cl_cache_dir() reuses cache_max_age days (#6). Geocoding calls Nominatim directly base tools instead osmdata::getbb(), works R installs whose curl package old httr2. ArcGIS reader honours server’s maxRecordCount exceededTransferLimit; server capping page_size longer silently truncates layer (#1).

title: cyclelanes 0.2.0

Sidewalks (footway=sidewalk) never facilities. cl_classify(strict = TRUE) drops shared paths paved surface tag (#3). highway=cycleway really -street lane drawn way – is_sidepath=yes, track tag, (sidepath_by_name = TRUE) street-like name – protected_lane mapped_separately = TRUE (#30).
